stories.title: Goldman Sachs, BNP Paribas divest over 68 lakh BSE shares worth Rs 2,186 crore ahead of Nifty 50 inclusion

en.title: Goldman Sachs, BNP Paribas divest over 68 lakh BSE shares worth Rs 2,186 crore ahead of Nifty 50 inclusion
en.summary: Goldman Sachs and BNP Paribas sold approximately 68.33 lakh BSE shares for Rs 2,186.44 crore through bulk deals before BSE's inclusion in the Nifty 50 index. UTI Mutual Fund and Nippon India Mutual Fund purchased 52.43 lakh of these shares, with BSE stock closing 3.31% higher at Rs 3,200.
